import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
k = rng.integers(0, 5, 10000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (5, 15))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (10000, 15)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(15)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]
